_howto: Copy this object into src/data/like.json (inside the [ ]), fill it in, delete the _ keys and this file stays as the template. The page appears at /like/{slug} and in the sitemap automatically. No em dashes. Keep 'same' and 'different' to 3 to 5 points each; each point starts with a short bolded-feeling lead sentence, then one or two sentences of detail.
name: Show Name as it appears on screen
title: Podcasts like Show Name
_title: Page title for search. 'Podcasts like X' or 'Shows like X' is what people type.
description: One or two sentences: who this page is for and what they'll get. Shows up under the heading and as the Google description.
about: Two or three sentences on what the other show is, for someone who hasn't heard of it. Creator, network or platform, years, what an episode is like.
same: Point 1. What REDACTED shares with it.
different: Point 1. How REDACTED is not like it. Be honest; this is what makes the page believable.

quote.text: Optional. A real quote about REDACTED from someone connected to the other show, or from press. Delete this whole key if you don't have one.

start: Which episode to start with for someone coming from that show, and why. Usually S1E1 with a reason; sometimes a specific case episode if it's the closest match.

faq.q: Is REDACTED as scary as Show Name?
Is REDACTED connected to Show Name?
Do I need to listen in order?
